contexts.text: Truths of faith, which are brooks and streams of waters (). AE 401:10.
The brook from Mount Sinai () = truth Divine, thus the Word in the letter, for this descends therefrom.
Man's life is a streamlet thence...

Mountains, hills, brooks, and valleys () = all things of the Church, from its first principles to its ultimates... Brooks and valleys = the truths and goods which are the ultimates of the Church... Brooks = the truths of doctrine there.
The streams of Judah () = the single particulars of the Lord's Celestial Kingdom, and also of the Word. AE 433:13.
Brooks () = wisdom; streams of waters, intelligence.
The river which is full of waters () = doctrine full of truths.
The rivers of waters are dried up () = the truths of doctrine dissipated through natural love.
